purpose: Teach: 一寸/やむなく/専ら/例える/かねてから/しなやか/でたらめ/おとなしい

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、一寸お母さんを手伝ってくれない?
lines.en: Sho, would you help Mom with something for a minute?
lines.style: Warm, practical tone. Light lift at the end—an invitation, not a demand. She's in the middle of something, needs his hands more than his attention right now.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、雨でやむなくお家にいたよ
lines.en: Mom, I had to stay home because of the rain.
lines.style: Quiet and matter-of-fact. He's explaining himself without complaint. A small, genuine tone—stating what happened. Slight pause before the 'because,' like he's thinking it through.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんは専ら新聞を読まれるのよ
lines.en: Sho, your father's been reading the newspaper the whole time.
lines.style: Gentle observation, slightly exasperated underneath. Not quite complaining—more noticing out loud. Warm toward her son, a little wry about the father. Steady, familiar tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖父ちゃんが「人生を花に例えると」って仰ってたよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa was saying something about comparing life to a flower.
lines.style: Soft, wondering tone. He's sharing something he heard and found interesting. Not quite understanding it fully, but holding it carefully. Slight emphasis on 'flower' like it matters.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんはかねてから旅行を計画されてたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father has been planning that trip for a long time.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact acknowledgment. A small sigh underneath—accepting, not resentful. She's telling him something he should know. Warm but slightly distracted, like she's thinking of something else while she speaks.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、しなやかな猫みたいに動きたいよ
lines.en: Mom, I want to move like a supple cat.
lines.style: Earnest and dreamy. He's testing the idea out loud, seeing if it sounds right. Slight brightness in his voice—he likes this thought. Not demanding, just wondering aloud.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、でたらめなお話は信じないようにね
lines.en: Sho, don't believe every nonsense story you hear.
lines.style: Gentle firmness. A small laugh underneath—she's not angry, just gently redirecting. She knows he's picked something up and she wants to guard him a little. Warm but clear.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、おとなしい子だってお祖父ちゃんが仰ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa said I'm a quiet kid.
lines.style: Simple pride. He's saying it like he understands it now. Small smile in his voice—pleased that someone noticed him that way. Ends with a gentle landing, no seeking approval—just sharing something true.
